cases.name: partial_commit
cases.setup: Interrupt a paid material operation before completion, then resume it.
cases.criterion: No premature result; exact paid progress and supported continuation.

cases.name: stale_basis
cases.setup: Change a required dependency during a partial operation.
cases.criterion: Reject or replan invalid continuation while retaining spent work and performed effects.

cases.name: resource_conflict
cases.setup: Two operations compete for the same exclusive resource.
cases.criterion: Prevent double spending and retain the failed or delayed attempt.

cases.name: delayed_delivery
cases.setup: Deliver evidence of a physical event to actors at different times.
cases.criterion: Maintain separate event, delivery, interpretation, and retention times.

engineering_choices: Integer energy and time: every completed work quantum costs one of each; no replenishment in this contract.
Prepare one quantum then execute the declared operation extent; exact progress is retained across checkpoints.
Exclusive reservations cover whole material instances, including stock containers. Waiting reserves nothing partially and spends no work.
Material quantity is lifetime stock; consumed quanta are an explicit irreversible sink counter. Available plus consumed equals quantity.
Material effects, observation delivery, reading, interpretation binding and acquired-use retention are separate commitments.
Participant policies see only detached U3 views. Reservation and stale-basis reasons are simulator-only until a permitted outcome is delivered.
Named procedures use only registered primitive executors and require actor-owned acquired-use evidence.
Integrated Model A and Fool Memory realization is U5; U4 routes are explicit engineering work stages.
additional_gates: All five migrated primitives: transfer, inspect, use, care and return have actual outcomes.
Condition damage, repair with tool wear, irreversible resource consumption and explicit return-obligation revision.
Zero budget, mismatched ownership, exhausted stock, unsupported procedure and cancelled job cannot produce an effect.
Stale target, tool, stock, procedure, definition and relation invalidate only unfinished dependent work; completed history persists.
Actual thread races and both deterministic interleavings cannot double-charge or double-spend.
Delayed observation has a causal source event; partial paid reading cannot expose contents; bind and acquisition are separately paid.
Checkpoint replay preserves pending operations, reservations, work, material state, actor views and idempotent command retries.
Independent audit from raw transactions verifies charges, material balances, performed effects and their source lineage.
All 32 U3 tests, 31 U2 tests, 71 selected inherited regressions, and U2/U3 witnesses pass.

panel.fixture: Deterministic workshop instances, both contender orders, and explicit concurrent threads; development acceptance only.

scope_limits: No U14 or R21C release claim
Trusted simulator boundary, not a hostile Python sandbox
